entry.title: Austria leads the Alps: 56 percent snow cover versus Germany's 7 percent
entry.summary: Austria has snow across 56 percent of measured terrain on 21 November, far ahead of Germany at 7 percent. Vorarlberg received 47 cm in three days.

entry.title: Swiss snow cover jumped 6,400 km² in seven days
entry.summary: Switzerland's white ground grew by 6,410 km² in one week. Latest snow model shows 19,880 km² covered as of 21 November.

entry.title: Switzerland: glaciers ahead, Glacier 3000 at 124 cm
entry.summary: Glacier 3000 leads Switzerland with 124 cm after 128 cm of snow in 72 hours. Snow cover jumped to 64% across the country on 20 November.

entry.title: Pyrenees forecast: rain reaches 3,260 m as freezing level climbs
entry.summary: Mixed rain and snow expected across the Pyrenees over the next three days, with the freezing level rising above resort summits by Sunday. New snow forecast between 13–24 cm at altitude.

entry.title: La Plagne snow depth: La Plagne 36 cm ahead of normal for November
entry.summary: Early-season snow in the Alps is running 38% above the 46-year average. La Plagne's mid-slopes hold 36 cm more than usual for this date, with heavy snow forecast through Sunday.

entry.title: The Sierra storm reaches Utah: 1 to 2 feet for the Wasatch from Alta and Snowbird to Snowbasin
entry.summary: The National Weather Service expects 10 to 20 inches in the Wasatch from Thursday to Saturday. Where Utah's snowpack stands against past winters, why Utah snow is lighter, and when to ski.

entry.title: North Lake Tahoe snow by the gauges: 17 inches in two days at Donner Summit, record start at Sugar Bowl and Northstar
entry.summary: What the measured snow gauges say about the North Lake Tahoe storm, why the first snow is heavy and wet, and how Sugar Bowl, Northstar and Diamond Peak compare with 46 winters.

entry.title: Mammoth Mountain gets over 2 feet of snow: how the 19 November storm compares with 46 winters
entry.summary: About 28 inches of new snow at Mammoth and 26 inches at June Mountain on 18-19 November. What the storm is, how it ranks against past winters, and the best days to go.

entry.title: Balkans snow in the last days: which country got the most? Slovenia, Croatia, Serbia, Montenegro and Bulgaria compared
entry.summary: From 13 to 19 November 2026 Slovenia got the most snow and kept it; Serbia and Croatia had a deep but short white weekend; Montenegro only on Durmitor; Bulgaria almost none. The ranking, with links to each country report.

entry.title: Bulgaria snow: Bansko, Borovets and Pamporovo almost bare on 19 November, what next week brings
entry.summary: Only Borovets and Bansko have a trace of snow at the top today, 2 cm each. A week ago Borovets had 11 cm. Day by day, and the one snowy day in the forecast.

entry.title: Serbia snow this week: a short white weekend on Zlatibor, Kopaonik still waiting
entry.summary: Tornik on Zlatibor had up to 39 cm on its upper slopes on 15 November 2026; by Wednesday it had melted. Kopaonik barely turned white. The week day by day and what comes next.

entry.title: Montenegro snow this week: Durmitor kept it, Kolašin did not (19 November 2026)
entry.summary: Savin Kuk above Žabljak picked up 22 cm of snow from 13 to 19 November and still has 6 cm today. Kolašin 1450 and 1600 are bare. The week day by day, and the next chances.

entry.title: Cheapest lift tickets in the western US for 2026-27: ski midweek for $49 to $99
entry.summary: Seven independent ski areas in the West where an adult day ticket costs from $49 to $98.8 on weekdays, compared with the snow they usually have in December.

entry.title: How to use the SnowScope ski trip planner
entry.summary: Pick a region, dates, budget and what matters; get every resort ranked with the likely snow at the start, the pass, hotel and food per person, chalets to book, and a game mode.

entry.title: Croatia snow: Gorski kotar and Velebit turned white on 13 November, then it melted
entry.summary: Up to 30 cm of snow fell on northern Velebit and Bjelolasica on Friday 13 November 2026. By Tuesday it was gone. Day by day, what the mountains kept, and when snow comes back.

entry.title: South Lake Tahoe's deepest 19 November in 46 winters: Heavenly, Sierra-at-Tahoe and Mt. Rose
entry.summary: Heavenly, Sierra-at-Tahoe and Mt. Rose have more snow on 19 November than in any winter since 1980-81. How much fell, the measured gauges, the weather behind it and the best days to go.

entry.title: Slovenia snow today: fresh snow on Kanin, Krvavec and Pokljuka, 19 November 2026
entry.summary: Snow is falling on Slovenia's ski mountains today: about 37 cm on Kanin and 21 cm on Krvavec. Where the snow lies, how it compares with past winters, and the next snowy day.

entry.title: Cheapest ski day pass in the Alps for 2026-27, and where you get the most runs
entry.summary: Alpine day passes from 36 EUR: nine resorts compared by price, kilometres of runs and the snow they usually hold, to find the best day of skiing for your money.

entry.title: Cheapest ski resorts in the Pyrenees for 2026-27, and the month to go
entry.summary: Pyrenees day passes from 46 EUR: six resorts in France, Spain and Andorra compared by price, then by the snow they usually have in December and January.

entry.title: Cheapest glacier ski pass for 2026-27: seven snow-sure glaciers compared
entry.summary: Glacier skiing from 68 EUR a day: we compared seven glaciers in France, Austria, Germany and Switzerland by price and by the snow they usually hold in December.

entry.title: Hakuba's first big snowstorm of 2026-27: snow at the top, rain at the base (19-25 November)
entry.summary: Hakuba Happo-one gets about 1.7 m of new snow at the top lift from 19 to 25 November, but rain at the base until 20 November. Day-by-day forecast at three heights.

entry.title: Cheapest 6-day ski pass in Europe 2026-27, and which ones really have snow
entry.summary: Six days of skiing from 191 EUR: we ranked ten cheap ski weeks in Europe by price, then checked 46 past winters to see where the snow is reliable.

entry.title: Early-season ski deals 2026: the cheapest opening weeks in the Alps
entry.summary: From 20 EUR on an opening weekend to 6-day passes before Christmas: a calendar of the cheapest early-season ski deals in the Alps for 2026, with the snow you can expect.

entry.title: Japan ski resorts snow forecast, 20-25 November 2026: Hakuba close to a metre, Hokkaido lighter
entry.summary: New snow forecast for 15 Japanese ski resorts from 20 to 25 November: Hakuba and Tsugaike lead with about 90 to 97 cm at the top, Niseko about 35 cm.

entry.title: Snow in Japan today: bare towns on 19 November, a big storm for the mountains
entry.summary: Only 3 of 318 snow stations in Japan had snow on the ground this morning. Here is where it is, what melted this week, and where the next snow falls.

entry.title: Northeast snow depth 18 Nov: what to wear on thin cover and warming days
entry.summary: Only 16 US Northeast resorts have skiable snow on 18 Nov. Thin cover and rain-crust risk mean careful gear choices. Forecasts for 19-21 Nov show no new snow.

entry.title: Sunshine Village snow forecast: 1,500 m freezing level brings rain risk Thursday
entry.summary: Freezing level reaches 1,500 m at Banff Sunshine Village on November 19. Fresh snow fell across Western Canada in the last 72 hours, but rain threatens the new powder.

entry.title: Western Canada: 90 cm in 14 days, most falling in week two
entry.summary: Western Canada forecast: 90 cm new snow at Mount Washington in the next two weeks, with 70 cm expected in late November and early December. Model run 2026-11-18.

entry.title: Alpine Meadows ski resort snow report: four times the November average
entry.summary: Fresh snow across the US West has built depths well above normal. At Palisades Tahoe Alpine Meadows, upper slopes hold 75 cm (measured 2026-11-18), compared to 10 cm typical for mid-November.

entry.title: Germany: 29 cm of snow forecast over the next week, peaking on 25 November
entry.summary: German mountains face significant snow arrival over seven days, with up to 29 cm possible. Data from 18 November.

entry.title: Romania: 25 cm new snow forecast in next week, peak on 23 November
entry.summary: Romania's mountains will see up to 25 cm of new snow in the next 7 days, with 12 cm expected on 23 November. Snow depth and forecast as of 18 November.

entry.title: UK snow by range: Southern Uplands lead with 24 cm in three days
entry.summary: Fresh snow fell unevenly across the UK hills in the past 72 hours. The Southern Uplands received the most, while cover above 1000 m is now complete. Data from 18 November.

entry.summary: A sudden thaw on 18 November removed most of Ukraine's snow cover in 24 hours. Only 430 km² remained, down from 2,350 km² yesterday. New snow is forecast.

entry.title: 27 Finnish resorts with snow cover: where the best base is building
entry.summary: 27 of Finland's 67 resorts have snow on 18 November. Upper slopes above 1000 m hold 41 cm on average across the country.

entry.title: Zermatt 47 cm: nine times deeper than a normal November
entry.summary: Zermatt has 47 cm on upper slopes today, 690% above the November median. The 0°C level stays above 2200 m through Friday.

entry.title: Austria: glaciers ahead, Stubaier Gletscher reaches 72 cm
entry.summary: Austria's glacier resorts lead the country after 14 cm fell in the last 72 hours. Snow cover grew to 18,140 km² as of 18 November.

entry.title: Where did France's snow land? Mont Blanc massif leads with 180 cm in three days
entry.summary: Fresh snow fell across France's high mountains in the past 72 hours. The Mont Blanc massif received the most: 180 cm. Data from 2026-11-18.

entry.title: Switzerland: Glacier 3000 leads at nearly double the typical mid-November depth
entry.summary: Swiss ski areas are running 142% of normal snow cover for November 18. Glacier 3000 tops the ranking with 52 cm, ahead of major storms forecast.

entry.title: Will the Alps get fresh snow this week? Up to 228 cm in the next two weeks
entry.summary: New snow forecast for the Alps through early December. Saint François Longchamp leads with 228 cm expected over 14 days, starting with 35 cm on Thursday.

entry.title: Italy: 95 cm incoming over the next week, with Friday as the heaviest day
entry.summary: Italy faces a major snow event: up to 95 cm is forecast for the next 7 days, with 34 cm expected on Friday 20 November. Data from 18 November.

entry.summary: Rapid snow loss across Italy on 17 November as temperatures rise. Only 12,540 km² remains covered, down from 21,210 km² yesterday. The Aosta Valley saw 134 cm of new snow in 72 hours.

entry.title: Norway braced for major snow: 39 cm expected in the week ahead

entry.title: 59 Swedish ski resorts now have snow cover across their terrain

entry.title: Alpine snow distribution after the storm: Valais Alps lead with 92 cm in 72 hours
entry.summary: Fresh snow fell unevenly across Swiss mountains. The Valais Alps received 92 cm in three days; the Bernese Oberland 54 cm. Data from 17 November.

entry.title: UK snow cover surged 6,810 km² in seven days
entry.summary: UK gained 8,380 km² of snow cover by 17 November. The North Pennines led with 27 cm in 72 hours.

entry.title: Ukraine 6% white, Poland 11%: Carpathian snow divide widening
